Thanksgiving travel will cost more. ⛽✈️
AAA says the national gas average was $3.81 on Nov. 16, versus $3.07 a year earlier. AAA-booked domestic round trips average about $800, up 17%.
AAA expects 81.5 million travelers this week.
Are you traveling or staying put?
